description: SEC Form ADV roster, monthly: every SEC-registered investment adviser and exempt reporting adviser (ERA). One row per firm (CRD): regulatory AUM in dollars, staff, clients, custody and Item 11 disciplinary flags. A current snapshot: snapshot_month is the last month the firm appeared. ERAs have null AUM. A disciplinary flag is a disclosure, not a verdict. Default: aum_total desc, 50 rows. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_investment_advisers

firm_name.description: Name part, any case; 1-3 chars = whole word.
